title: Moore hands Aquarius document to Benowitz in a supply closet
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Moore hands Aquarius document to Benowitz in a supply closet, about c. 1981 at Sandia National Laboratories, Albuquerque, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And they go in the the the supply closet, he said. And he turned the radio up. And he gave him the thing and said, "I was told to give this to you. Take it with a grain of salt."

plain: A writer named Greg Bishop retells a story from 1981 in Albuquerque, New Mexico, about a UFO researcher named Bill Moore and a local businessman named Paul Bennewitz. Bishop says the two went into a supply closet at Bennewitz's office, turned the radio up, and Moore handed him the Aquarius document, a paper said to describe a secret government UFO project, saying he had been told to pass it on and to take it with a grain of salt. Told this way, it would mean someone was deliberately feeding Bennewitz material.
